items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: No, I don't remember playing with him.

ctx.x: No, Celestan was all, I can tell you at that time there were three big bands, Celestan, Sidney Desbenes, Sonny South, Pierron, all the guys from 10 to 11 there. Yeah, yeah.
Did you ever play with, we talked to all of the losers in the last week or so, Peter Lacazze, did you ever play with him?
No, I don't remember playing with him. But all the regular guys, Nelson, the trombone player, George Nelson. That's his brother, huh?
